request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  502
error[ZC-E0215]: the store went backwards or forked
  cause  the store is behind: writes it acknowledged are gone
  cause  the server remembers revision 412 (a1a1a1a1); the store is at revision
         398 (e5e5e5e5)
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    look at which store this is; to keep it as it is, run   zcube store accept-rollback --confirm
  more   zcube explain E0215
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0215.html
